title: File:Chiang Mai City Old Map Lan Na Kingdom.png
author: Unknown authorUnknown author
description: Chiang Mai City old map during the Lan Na kingdom (in Thailand). The portrait of a ruler (king) is on the left side. There is a castle, palace, temples, local houses, the treasury, the city wall with a moat around all 4 sides and multiple gates, roads, farmland with people, farmers with traditional ox carts, wildlife in the forest, lakes. The Mae Nam Ping river flows with boats on the east side. C
